svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE · PIECEWISE CUDA GRAPHS & TORCH.COMPILE (#389)
vLLM V1 Piecewise CUDA Graphs + torch.compile vs. Decode-Only Graphs
Splitting Static Linear/MLP Subgraphs Around Dynamic Attention Accelerates Mixed Chunked-Prefill Batches by 1.54x (-68.8% HBM)
Tier 2 Trap: Legacy Decode-Only Full CUDA Graphs
• Full-model CUDA Graph requires static query_len=1 (Decode only!)
• Whenever a Chunked Prefill enters the batch, vLLM V0 falls back
to slow Eager Mode (21.8 ms step) for the entire mixed batch!
• Eats 4.8 GB/GPU Private Graph Pool (Stealing KV Cache Space)
• Splits graph at dynamic FlashAttention boundaries (Piecewise!)
• Captures token-wise GEMM + RMSNorm + RoPE + SwiGLU by num_tokens
• Accelerates BOTH Decode (8.9 ms) & Mixed Chunked-Prefill (14.2 ms)!
• Only 1.5 GB Graph Pool (-68.8% HBM) & 3.8s Cached Warm Startup
4-Tier CUDA Graph & Compilation Matrix (70B-FP8 · 2x H100 TP=2 · 32 Buckets)
Tier 1 (Eager Mode --enforce-eager) : Decode TPOT = 14.8ms | Mixed Step = 22.5ms | Graph HBM = 0.0 GB | Boot = 0.0s
Tier 2 (V0 Decode-Only Full Graph) : Decode TPOT = 10.6ms | Mixed Step = 21.8ms | Graph HBM = 4.8 GB | Boot = 24.0s
Tier 3 (Uncached torch.compile) : Decode TPOT = 9.4ms | Mixed Step = 20.5ms | Graph HBM = 4.2 GB | Boot = 145.0s
Tier 4 (V1 Piecewise + Disk Cache) : Decode TPOT = 8.9ms | Mixed Step = 14.2ms | Graph HBM = 1.5 GB | Boot = 3.8s
